question: If 30% of a number exceeds 20% of it by 12, then the number is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **number** be 100%.

Difference in percentages = 30% − 20% = 10%.

Given, 10% of the number = 12.

So, 100% of the number = 12 × 10 = 120.

**∴ The correct answer is 120.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**First percentage** = 30%

**Second percentage** = 20%

**Difference value** = 12

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef0a969034c76f0068c81a60c2aea9ccf444383ed3c3dc38e7f023e3fea7873b.png] 

**Calculation:**

Let the **number** be x.

⇒ (30/100) × x − (20/100) × x = 12

⇒ (10/100) × x = 12

⇒ 0.1x = 12

⇒ x = 12 ÷ 0.1

⇒ x = 120

**∴ The correct answer is 120.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Difference

When comparing two percentages of the same base, the absolute difference in value is equal to the difference in percentages multiplied by the base value (Number × (P₁% − P₂%) = Difference).

Base Value Concept

In percentage problems, the original number is always considered as 100% unless specified otherwise.</p
